mapper.sql: AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS cancel_payment INNER JOIN payment_cancellations AS cancellation ON cancellation.payment_id = cancel_payment.id WHERE cancel_payment.order_id = custom_order.id AND cancellation.status = 'REQUESTED' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders AS custom_order WHERE custom_order.order_type = 'CUSTOM' AND custom_order.status = 'UNDER_REVIEW'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.status = 'ABORTED' OR ( payment.status = 'EXPIRED' AND payment.expiration_checked_at IS NULL ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment_cancellations AS cancellation WHERE cancellation.payment_id = payment.id AND cancellation.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'FAILED') AND NOT ( cancellation.request_type = 'SYSTEM_COMPENSATION' AND cancellation.status = 'FAILED' AND cancellation.failure_code = 'PAYMENT_COMPLETED' ) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders AS custom_order WHERE custom_order.order_type = 'CUSTOM' AND custom_order.status = 'IN_PRODUCTION'

SELECT pickup_order.id AS order_id, pickup_order.pickup_at, pickup_order.order_number, CONCAT( COALESCE( ( SELECT order_item.product_name FROM order_items AS order_item WHERE order_item.order_id = pickup_order.id ORDER BY order_item.id LIMIT 1 ), '주문 상품 없음' ), CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items AS order_item WHERE order_item.order_id = pickup_order.id ) > 1 THEN CONCAT( ' 외 ', ( SELECT COUNT(*) - 1 FROM order_items AS order_item WHERE order_item.order_id = pickup_order.id ), '개' ) ELSE '' END ) AS product_name, pickup_order.status FROM orders AS pickup_order WHERE pickup_order.pickup_at >= #{start} AND pickup_order.pickup_at < #{end} AND pickup_order.status = 'READY_FOR_PICKUP' ORDER BY pickup_order.pickup_at, pickup_order.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT recent_order.id AS order_id, recent_order.order_number, CONCAT( COALESCE( ( SELECT order_item.product_name FROM order_items AS order_item WHERE order_item.order_id = recent_order.id ORDER BY order_item.id LIMIT 1 ), '주문 상품 없음' ), CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items AS order_item WHERE order_item.order_id = recent_order.id ) > 1 THEN CONCAT( ' 외 ', ( SELECT COUNT(*) - 1 FROM order_items AS order_item WHERE order_item.order_id = recent_order.id ), '개' ) ELSE '' END ) AS product_name, recent_order.status, recent_order.final_amount FROM orders AS recent_order ORDER BY recent_order.created_at DESC, recent_order.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products AS low_stock_product WHERE low_stock_product.status = 'ACTIVE' AND low_stock_product.product_type = 'GENERAL' AND low_stock_product.stock_quantity BETWEEN 0 AND 2

SELECT low_stock_product.id AS product_id, low_stock_product.name AS product_name, low_stock_product.stock_quantity FROM products AS low_stock_product WHERE low_stock_product.status = 'ACTIVE' AND low_stock_product.product_type = 'GENERAL' AND low_stock_product.stock_quantity BETWEEN 0 AND 2 ORDER BY low_stock_product.stock_quantity, low_stock_product.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT post_report.post_id) FROM post_reports AS post_report JOIN posts AS post ON post.id = post_report.post_id WHERE post_report.status = 'PENDING' AND post.status <> 'DELETED'
